changelog:
- Updated description and documentation to emphasize agent compatibility and AI-driven scheduling.
- Clarified that the skill coordinates meetings for both humans and their agents.
- Standardized terminology (e.g., "Schedule a Meeting" heading, consistent reference to Doodle alternative).
- No changes to core workflow or functionality; documentation improvements only.
summary: Schedule a meeting for humans and their agents. Creates a scheduling poll, distributes it, collects votes, and finds the best time. Use when someone needs to find a time that works for a group. A Doodle alternative built for the age of AI agents.
